_comment: Tier-2: shallow-water gravity is the SCALAR ProcessInfo entry GRAVITY_Z — not a GRAVITY vector and not a nodal variable; the elements read only that. Pitfall (kratos.shallow_water #2). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). KM.GRAVITY_Z resolves and its repr identifies it as 'component 2 of GRAVITY'; ProcessInfo.SetValue(GRAVITY_Z, 9.81) reads back 9.81. The wrong route the claim names is tested too: reading GRAVITY_Z off a node that has not had GRAVITY added raises RuntimeError 'This container only can store the variables specified in its variables list. The variables list doesn't have this variable:GRAVITY_Z', so gravity is genuinely not a nodal quantity here. The claim's own failure mode is silent (g=0, nothing moves), which is why the location of the value is the only signal. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX SHIFTED by the guidance reclassification; the claim this fixture verifies is unchanged and every #index quoted above is the current one. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS the expected outcome of all 5 probes -- it asserts the opposite of what this build actually does, while leaving each probe's callable untouched so every probe still really runs against Kratos. Every probe[...] line then disagrees with itself and probe_mismatches goes from 0 to 5. This proves the printed booleans come from actually calling into Kratos on this build, and that a wrong claim is caught, rather than the fixture echoing a hard-coded table. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 5 probe[<label>]=<ok>_expected=<must> lines, probe_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/shallowwater_gravity_is_scalar_processinfo && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
